name: alta-slides
description: Extensão do Chrome para exportar slides do Google Slides em 300 dpi.

scripts.zip: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/alta-slides && cp -R manifest.json popup.html popup.css popup.js renderer.html renderer.css renderer.js content.js assets lib styles vendor README.md LICENSE dist/alta-slides/ && find dist/alta-slides -name '.DS_Store' -delete && cd dist && zip -qr alta-slides-1.0.0.zip alta-slides
